## 412. Conditional weights, shares and the exit from a margin on the counting layer (UE2)

The free-energy principle states belief, surprisal and a free-energy bound; UE1's premise card ([UE1](../../development/ue1-fep-bridge/NOTE.md)) recorded that the core had weights over courses but no conditioning, share or surprisal. UE2 ([note](../../development/ue2-conditional-weights/NOTE.md)) states them on the counting layer the core has, `Becoming.Weighted`'s mass and `Becoming.Typicality`'s courses, with no division, real number or logarithm, and lands Kolmogorov's maximal inequality in Typicality below `typical`.

**The re-point.** The three other records that bind `Typicality.lean`, weights-count-situations, drift-offspring-sampled and fixation-by-drift, cite no declaration that changed. capture-by-counted-choices takes 03 as a statement without citing a part of it, so the rewritten Typicality paragraph of 03 §6 puts it out of date, though it states nothing that paragraph says. The four are re-pointed as bookkeeping with `python3 -B tools/research/repoint.py --reason "UE2: Typicality.lean gains typical_throughout (Kolmogorov's maximal inequality) below typical, the margin square with two_mul_le_of_le derived from it, and loses offBy_le, and the declarations these records cite are unchanged; 03's Typicality paragraph gains the bound at every step, which capture-by-counted-choices does not state" --ids weights-count-situations drift-offspring-sampled fixation-by-drift capture-by-counted-choices --paths experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Typicality.lean theories/becoming/chapters/03-KNOWING.md --receipt experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/becoming-checks/20261025T163242.561061Z/verification.json --lean experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Typicality.lean`, run first as a dry run and then with `--apply`, which logs one line of `_process/architecture/rebinds.jsonl`. typicality-by-counting, whose claim gains a law, carries a history note instead, written with its new binding.

**What UE2 pays and does not.** It pays two of the principle's three quantities in counting form: belief, as the posterior share, and pointwise surprisal, through the reciprocal share, which orders as surprisal does and multiplies where surprisal adds. Averages of logarithms, entropy and free energy, have no reciprocal-share form; free energy and its bound, Gibbs' inequality with its equality case at the posterior, are drafted for the periphery over the reals and claimed nowhere until a checker gives them a receipt. The conditioning laws are identities of counting. The exit bound is the unregulated case a reading of persisting is measured against: void from n = m·m/(p·q), it gives the principle's containment no third part.

**The review.** An independent read-only review by a separate AI agent with a Lean rebuild ([REVIEW-UE2](../../development/ue2-conditional-weights/REVIEW-UE2.md)) found the Lean sound and the text overclaiming: 1 error, 4 overclaims, 11 imprecisions, 3 suggestions. All were taken: the free-energy reading of the exit bound and the candidate third part dropped; the conditioning laws labelled near-definitional; the prior-share premise, the natural-weighting scope and shares with a zero whole stated; "falls to the need" told apart from a break; the record laws' hypotheses asked of the courses of k steps; the margin lemmas moved into Typicality and the binomial mean left to Drift (rule 9); `given` renamed `restrict`; the periphery's missing declaration, its equality case and its support form fixed. The reviewer's re-check found 18 findings addressed and one partly, with five small new issues, none blocking the core; all were taken before landing (only `⟨0, 0⟩` compares either way; Weighted's owner, not a recompile, keeps `whole_courses` above `transfer_weight`; the record fields; the periphery not stated as checked; "drift" in one sense).

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. A share read as a probability is a number of situations of a kind, so conditioning, Bayes's rule and a posterior are counting. Given the weighting, a record of the course so far bears on a break within the horizon only through the margin it shows and the steps it leaves: the counting form of T6's seen half, with the weighting as the independently warranted model T6 allows.
